title: The Negami Polynomial and Broken-Circuit Stanley--Reisner Rings
summary: We summarize the classical passage from the chromatic specialization of Negami's polynomial to the Hilbert series of a broken-circuit Stanley--Reisner ring, and record formulas for several graph families with their connectivity hypotheses made explicit. Our main construction in this revision is the associated graded algebra of the squarefree edge algebra under the graphic-matroid rank filtration, for an arbitrary finite loopless graph.
